v4.6.86 — IBKR: resolve more tickers + quiet 'no security definition' noise

🐛 FIXED
• Some valid stocks (e.g. CTRA) failed IBKR's bare SMART lookup with 'Error 200 — No security definition'. The bot now retries qualification with the listing exchange (NYSE / NASDAQ / ARCA / …), so those tickers resolve and trade instead of erroring.
• If IBKR genuinely has no contract for a symbol, the bot now SKIPS it cleanly with one short line and caches the result — no more repeated Error 200 / 'Unknown contract' spam every cycle.
• Qualified contracts are cached, and pricing/orders/brackets all use the same robust lookup.

Applies to every IBKR bot — this one and all future bots created in the app. (Server-side framework updated too, so cloud bots get it immediately.)

Update via the in-app banner.
